items.text: Puka Nacua listed QUESTIONABLE (calf) on ETR Sunday injury dump; McVay noted majority Thursday practice but lacked power/explosion, will test pregame.
items.why: Calf injury; stopped practice lacking explosion; pregame test planned.
items.implication: Game-time; if OUT, heavy TE funnel for Rams with Adams also out.
items.opportunity: TE target share spike (historically 37% with Puka out).

items.text: Lamar Jackson QUESTIONABLE (ankle) per ETR dump and Ravens official listing; said heading in right direction after limited practice.
items.why: Ankle; limited practice, positive comments from player/coach.
items.implication: Crucial for Ravens offense/DFS; game-time decision possible vs Bengals.

items.text: Breece Hall QUESTIONABLE (quad) on ETR Sunday list; returned to practice, status key for Jets-Dolphins.
items.implication: If active vs MIA, startable; Berry would insert immediately.

items.text: Mike Evans and Deebo Samuel both OUT for 49ers vs Falcons; Shanahan/Schefter confirm Evans (Achilles/ribs), Deebo (hamstring).
items.why: Evans Achilles/ribs; Deebo hamstring; coach and Schefter ruled out.
items.implication: Severe WR depletion funnels targets to Kittle and possible CMC slot work.
items.opportunity: Kittle/CMC routes and red-zone share expand significantly.

items.text: Schefter official OUTs include Mike Evans, Deebo Samuel, Brian Robinson, Emeka Egbuka, Tyler Warren, David Montgomery, Jeremiyah Love, Rashee Rice, Zach Charbonnet, Davante Adams among others.
items.implication: Multiple handcuff/beneficiary activations; clear starters for backups.
items.opportunity: Role expansion for teammates (e.g. Bijan full with BRob out).

items.text: LOVE Saquon Barkley if active vs DAL (efficient prior, great matchup); LOVE Breece Hall if plays vs MIA (insert straight into lineups despite Stephania caution).
items.why: Practice returns; matchup data (DAL soft vs RBs); volume expected.
items.implication: Immediate starters if cleared; monitor final status.
items.opportunity: Lead back carries/snaps vs favorable defenses.
items.conflict: Stephania Bell more cautious on Breece immediate insert.

items.text: If Puka Nacua (calf) can't go, Stafford hierarchy: 1. Tyler Higbee 2. Konata Mumpfield 3. Colby Parkinson 4. Tutu Atwell etc. Adams already long-term out.
items.why: McVay pregame test details; historical TE share 37% when Puka out.
items.implication: Higbee primary beneficiary; stash/stream TEs in Rams offense.
items.opportunity: TE routes/targets/red-zone spike; Berry notes same 37% TE share fact.

items.text: Colston Loveland BACK/LOVE: since Caleb Williams return, 30% target share, 19.2 PPR PPG, 6+ rec and 60+ yards both games. Kmet IR cements role.
items.why: Usage spike with Caleb; Kmet season-ending confirms lead TE.
items.implication: Must-start TE1; strong ROS with Williams.
items.opportunity: 30% ts, high routes, red-zone with no Kmet competition.

items.text: Brian Robinson OUT creates sweet setup for Bijan Robinson: 49ers D inflating opposing RB production 4.4% (7th-most), recent RB catches/TDs conceded; Bijan full workload + SF DvP.
items.why: BRob hamstring OUT confirmed; 49ers recent RB receptions data + DvP.
items.implication: Bijan RB1 smash spot vs depleted SF front.
items.opportunity: Full snaps/carries/routes vs soft RB DvP; no committee threat.

items.text: George Kittle will go nuts with entire 49ers WR corps hurt (Evans/Deebo OUT); scheme + talent. Rarely buy RB-as-WR but CMC slot temptation real given dire WR situation and Kaelon Black.
items.why: WR injuries confirmed; CMC smile on slot question; Kittle always elite.
items.implication: Kittle TE1 smash; CMC possible extra receiving upside.
items.opportunity: Kittle funnel targets/routes; CMC slot snaps if deployed.
items.conflict: Levitan notes RB-as-WR rarely materializes historically.

items.text: Luther Burden only 68.8% routes but elite 2.56 YPRR; Kmet IR may reduce 2-/3-sets giving Burden even more juice. Loveland already producing with Caleb.
items.why: YPRR data + Kmet season-ending IR confirmed.
items.implication: Burden breakout candidate; Loveland locked TE1 ROS.
items.opportunity: Higher route share for Burden; Loveland uncontested TE snaps/targets.

items.text: TreVeyon Henderson played just 21% of snaps over last three weeks; clear downgrade in role/usage.
items.why: Snap share data last 3 weeks only 21%.
items.implication: Sit/fade until role expands; not a reliable starter.

items.text: LOVE A.J. Brown: Week 6 97% routes, 33% target share (led team) despite 3 catches/3 drops/27 yards on 10 targets; buying the usage @ CHI.
items.why: Elite route/target share despite poor efficiency; matchup vs Bears.
